fullPassage:
Since the year 2000, the Serpentine Gallery in the UK has annually invited distinguished architects from around the world to design a pavilion, which provides a place of rest for visitors.

(A) The pavilion's roof, resembling the wide branches of a tree, includes a transparent layer that allows sunlight to spread into the pavilion below. Visitors may enter the pavilion through one of its four entrances and sit around the central ring to look up at the sky.

(B) In 2017, the honor was extended to Kéré. Drawing inspiration from his hometown, where locals would gather to work, converse, and study beneath the shade of trees, he modeled his design after a large tree.

(C) The pavilion's exterior walls, shaped like triangles and made of blue wooden blocks, reflect Kéré's cultural heritage. In his hometown, residents traditionally wear blue clothing during times of celebration, and the triangles symbolize luck and confidence.

questions.passage: The role of architects is often <u>ⓐ associated</u> with the design of luxury buildings. Architects mainly focus on how unique and extraordinary the buildings they design are, and thus it is easy <u>ⓑ to forget</u> how architecture can modify places and give people better living conditions. Architects need to think about <u>ⓒ using</u> architecture as a tool for the development of communities that <u>ⓓ responds</u> to the current needs of society, even in places that lack money and building technologies, and Diébédo Francis Kéré is doing exactly that <u>ⓔ in</u> Africa.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 사회의 현재 필요에 부응하는 공동체 발전을 위한 도구. 관계대명사 that의 선행사는 communities(복수)이므로 동사도 복수형 respond가 되어야 합니다. responds(3인칭 단수)는 어법에 맞지 않습니다.
det.analysis: 원문: a tool for the development of communities that responds to the current needs of society
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Francis Kéré, a winner of the Pritzker Prize, was born in Burkina Faso, one of the poorest countries in Africa. The conditions of the school he attended (B) <u>[was / were]</u> very poor. The classroom, hastily constructed from cement, (C) <u>[was filled / filling]</u> with over a hundred children.

questions.passage: Francis Kéré, a winner of the Pritzker Prize, was born in Burkina Faso, one of the poorest countries in Africa. The region in Africa where he grew up didn't have any electricity or running water. When he was seven, he had to move 13 km away to attend school. Although Kéré could have given up his dreams, he remained determined to study. While still a young student, he was awarded a scholarship to study carpentry in Germany. Even though he became a globally recognized architect in Germany, he has not forgotten his roots. His architectural designs are deeply influenced by his love for Africa and a profound sense of pride in his people.

questions.passage: For his first project, he managed to raise $30,000 to build an elementary school in his native village, Gando. Instead of using more conventional modern materials like concrete, glass, and steel, he chose to use clay, embracing the traditional building methods of Africa. He made bricks by mixing clay, a locally available material, with 10% cement. This mixture helps keep classrooms cool during hot weather. Additionally, he used bricks with holes in them to make the ceiling and built a high roof using a contemporary architectural system to let hot air escape. The large overhanging roof provides shade and protects the clay bricks from heavy rain.

questions.passage: Even though he became a globally recognized architect in Germany, he has not forgotten his roots. His architectural designs are deeply influenced by his love for Africa and a profound sense of pride in his people.

다음 <조건>에 맞게 주어진 우리말을 영작하시오.

[조건] 보기의 단어를 모두 사용하여 영작 / 필요시 어형 변환 / 10단어 내외
[보기] he / not / forget / his / root
[우리말] 그는 자신의 뿌리를 잊지 않았다.

det.korean: 그는 자신의 뿌리를 잊지 않았다. 현재완료(has not forgotten)로 과거부터 현재까지 계속되는 상태를 표현합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: he has not forgotten his roots
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: While still a young student, he was awarded a scholarship to study carpentry in Germany. He finished his high school studies in Germany and went on to attend university there as well.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 형태로 고쳐 쓰시오.

While still a young student, he was awarded a scholarship (study) carpentry in Germany.

det.korean: 목공을 공부하기 위한 장학금. 명사(scholarship) 뒤에서 목적·용도를 나타내는 to부정사(형용사적 용법)가 와야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: a scholarship to study carpentry
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
